{"id":1963415363,"question_id":2978,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1774843314,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"4 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1963415363/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Check if Strings Can be Made Equal With Operations II","memory":"19.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool checkStrings(string s1, string s2) {\n        vector<char>even(26 , 0);\n        vector<char>odd(26 , 0);\n\n        for(int i=0; i<s1.size(); i++)\n        {\n            if(i%2 == 0)\n            {\n                even[s1[i] - 'a']++;\n                even[s2[i] - 'a']--;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                odd[s1[i] - 'a']++;\n                odd[s2[i] - 'a']--;\n            }\n        }\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<26 ; i++) if(even[i] or odd[i]) return false;\n        return true;\n    } \n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"check-if-strings-can-be-made-equal-with-operations-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1893}
